Sulfasalazine is a widely used anti - inflammatory agent in the treatment of inflammatory bowel disease and several rheumatological disorders . Although as thrilled as 20 % of treated patients may experience reversible , dose - dependent side effects , less frequent but potentially severe , systemic reactions have also been reported . A severe systemic reaction to sulfasalazine developed in a 27 - year old female with rheumatoid arthritis characterized by eosinophilia , granulomatous enteritis and myelotoxicity , cholestatic hepatitis , and seizures . The clinical course and management of this patient are presented as well as a review of the incidence and outcome of severe systemic reactions to sulfasalazine .

To study the efficiency and safety of holmium : YAG laser lithotripsy for ureteral stones . A series of 188 patients with 208 ureteral stones were treated with semirigid ureteroscopy and holmium : YAG laser lithotripsy from February 2003 to January 2005 . Of the stones , 116 were lower ureteral , 46 middle ureteral , and 55 upper ureteral . The success rate was 92.7 % at the time of ureteroscopy and 96.7 % at 3 months . The failures were secondary to shoulder of the stones ( 3.3 % ) . There were no perforations and one stricture . Stenting was done in 90 % of patients .
